description: Creative brief of "Changsheng" (signed off by the user)
content:
# "Changsheng" creative brief

- One-sentence story: a researcher working on longevity genes is bitten by a lab monkey and, on the way home in a taxi, turns as savage as the monkey.
- Running time: 30 seconds, about 6 shots. 16:9. Realistic, cold, oppressive.
- Main characters: the researcher (cast); the lab monkey.
- Sound: ambient only, one line from the taxi driver.
- Generation plan: images from Seedream, video from Seedance, through xsb's media tool server, held to the budget.
- Cap on generation costs: 150 yuan (the budget in the settings); estimated 60–100.
- Reshoots and non-negotiables: at most three rounds per shot; the researcher's face must stay the same.
- Delivery: 720p mp4.

name: changsheng
description: Script of "Changsheng", v1 (signed off by the user)
content:
INT. LAB - DAY
The researcher leans over the lab monkey's cage. The monkey lunges at the door; she pulls her hand back, blood on its back.

INT. TAXI - DAY
She slumps in the back seat, pale, breathing harder and harder. DRIVER: "Miss, are you all right?"

## Style suffix
Realistic cinematic look, cold palette, low saturation, shallow depth of field, slow steady camera, no text in frame.
